description.text: Objectives The undergraduate program in International Trade and Economics provides students with solid theory and the latest technological knowledge in economics and international trade. The program covers business related issues such as Chinese culture, China's policies on foreign trade, and China’s major trading partners. Students should be able to engage in various business, management, and international trade activities in government agencies or multinational companies.Duration Duration of the program is 4 years with course works in the first three years, followed by a thesis project and practice.Degree Awarded A bachelor degree in economics is awarded for students who meet the requirement for graduation.Main Courses Politics & Economics, International Economics, Econometrics, Statistics, Accounting, World Economics, International Trade Practice, Monetary Banking, Finance.

duration.text: The International Trade and Economics at Harbin Institute of Technology(Shenzhen Campus) is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1) A copy of passport (the original passport will be checked during registration) 2) One passport-size photo (35mm*50mm) 3) Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4) Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. 2. Be Healthy.3. Under the age of 304. Have attained a senior high school diploma with good marks.5. Have solid financial support to afford the study and living expense in China.6. Good English reading, writing and speaking skills.
